outcome: When I review a software change, help me focus quickly on requirements that still need stronger evidence or human judgment, without changing the underlying requirements, evidence, or approval state.
successCriterion: The review can open focused on evidence gaps, switch back to all requirements, change grouping, and inspect why each item is considered supported or still open while every source record remains read-only.

decisions.label: How should review items be organized?

acceptanceScenarios.title: Start with unresolved evidence needs
acceptanceScenarios.given: the review contains requirements with different evidence strength or human-review status
acceptanceScenarios.then: the initial focus emphasizes requirements that lack executed evidence or still require human judgment

acceptanceScenarios.title: Return to the complete review
acceptanceScenarios.given: I am focused on evidence gaps
acceptanceScenarios.then: every requirement in the exact source revision becomes visible again

acceptanceScenarios.title: Explain why an item is open or supported
acceptanceScenarios.given: a requirement is visible in the review
acceptanceScenarios.then: I can see its source state, evidence references, evidence classification, and what remains unproven

acceptanceScenarios.title: Filtering never edits source truth
acceptanceScenarios.given: I change focus, grouping, or covered-item visibility
acceptanceScenarios.then: requirement state, evidence state, and approval state remain unchanged

implementationImpact.label: Evidence review candidate runtime
reasons: Render exact requirement/evidence truth with task-first filtering and grouping controls.

implementationImpact.label: Evidence Gap Focus implementation adapter
reasons: Own the feature-specific decision vocabulary and read-only authority constraints.

verification.statement: These acceptance scenarios are planned checks. Their presence does not mean the generated candidate built successfully or that a person accepted the review experience.
